description: This file implements a PagingSource for fetching and paginating 'Order' objects from an OrderRepository, supporting Android's Paging library for efficient data loading.

classes.name: OrderPagingSource
classes.description: A PagingSource implementation that loads pages of Order objects from the specified OrderRepository, with support for page size and filters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a page of Order data based on the provided LoadParams, returning either a page of data or an error.

methods.name: getRefreshKey
methods.description: Provides the key for reloading data when refreshing, based on the current PagingState.
